headline: 13.2 million videos removed from TikTok in Bangladesh
summary: The platform removed over 13.2 million videos from Bangladesh in the first quarter of 2024 for violating community guidelines.
details: TikTok has removed 13,218,404 videos uploaded from Bangladesh between January and March 2024 for violating its community guidelines.
According to a press release, 94.4% of these videos were automatically removed within 24 hours of being posted.
Globally, the platform removed 184,012,576 videos in the first quarter, representing approximately 0.5% of all videos uploaded to the platform.
Of the global total, 178,014,154 videos were identified and removed automatically. However, 8.8 million videos were restored after further review.
To maintain safety and trust, TikTok also deleted 237,517,128 comments and 86,288,705 fake accounts in the same period.
Additionally, 25,764,372 accounts belonging to users under the age of 13 were removed from the platform.
Regarding content types, 18.6% of removed videos globally contained sensitive content that did not align with content policies, and 12.6% violated safety and social behavior guidelines.
caption:
Over 13.2 million TikTok videos from Bangladesh were wiped out in just three months.

TikTok has removed 13,218,404 videos uploaded from Bangladesh between January and March 2024 for violating its community guidelines.

According to a press release, 94.4% of these videos were automatically removed within 24 hours of being posted.

Globally, the platform removed 184,012,576 videos in the first quarter, representing approximately 0.5% of all videos uploaded to the platform.

Of the global total, 178,014,154 videos were identified and removed automatically. However, 8.8 million videos were restored after further review.

To maintain safety and trust, TikTok also deleted 237,517,128 comments and 86,288,705 fake accounts in the same period.

Additionally, 25,764,372 accounts belonging to users under the age of 13 were removed from the platform.

Regarding content types, 18.6% of removed videos globally contained sensitive content that did not align with content policies, and 12.6% violated safety and social behavior guidelines.

headline_marked: Nearly [[40% of total bank deposits held by millionaires]] in Bangladesh
headline: Nearly 40% of total bank deposits held by millionaires in Bangladesh
summary: While millionaires hold 40% of deposits, accounts with under 1 lakh BDT make up 90% of all bank accounts but hold only 4% of the money.
details: According to Bangladesh Bank data, nearly 40% of all deposits in the country's government and private banks are held in millionaire accounts. Specifically, accounts with 1 crore to over 50 crore BDT hold 39.81% of the total deposits.
The wealth concentration is stark: accounts with 1 lakh to 99 lakh BDT hold another 56% of deposits. Together, millionaires and lakhpatis control 96% of the total money in the banking system.
In contrast, accounts with deposits between 1 Taka and 99,999 Taka make up approximately 90% of all bank accounts but hold only 4% of the total deposits.
As of March, total deposits in all banks stood at 21.58 lakh crore BDT. Of this, 8.59 lakh crore BDT is held by the 1.36 lakh accounts categorized as millionaire accounts.
Recent trends show further concentration; nearly half of the new deposits entering the banking system between December and March went into millionaire accounts.

Experts note that these figures include both individual and institutional accounts. Large government agencies, ministries, and private corporations naturally hold significantly higher balances than individual citizens.
The most extreme concentration is seen in accounts with over 50 crore BDT. Only 2,074 such accounts exist, yet they hold 3.06 lakh crore BDT, averaging 148 crore BDT per account.
